{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
An '''astrophysicist''' was someone who studied [[Realspace/Legends|spatial]] physics and [[Astronomer/Legends|astronomy]]. The job usually required a high amount of education prior to commencing a career in astrophysics, particularly in the physical sciences.<ref name="Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> 

The [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] on [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] had an astrophysicist assigned to the base during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Alongside a [[marine biologist]], the scientists were studying the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] unusual [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] waves.<ref name="BFGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref> The [[Extragalactic Society]] hired numerous astrophysicists, including [[Danni Quee]].<ref name="Vector Prime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
[[Regalia Sub-space station-12]] director [[mOKDAR 15]] was a member of the [[Society for the Refusal of Astrophysics]], an anti-astrophysics association that produced [[Standard month/Legends|monthly]] publications.<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
